text: かがくの　ちからって　すげー！

structure.jp: かがくの　ちからって

patterns.name: 〜って (topic)
patterns.explanation: って after a thing is a casual way to hold it up as what you are about to comment on, like は with feeling. かがくの　ちからって = 'the power of science, well, it...'.

patterns.name: 〜い
patterns.explanation: すげー is the rough, slangy way of saying すごい, with the ending stretched into えー. すげー = 'amazing!'.
